status: proposed; offline estimate only; paid execution awaits budget decision
concurrency_scope: two independent arms; serial questions within an arm
baseline: Full visible conversation before question; drop oldest whole turns only if byte/window budget exceeded. Record every truncation.
memoria: Public session windows -> external working sources -> native formation/review/consolidation -> Kernel.answer(KnowledgeAnswer) with adaptive retrieval and publication checks. No personal user injection.
judge: Independent binary LLM with frozen adapted permissive rubric; no arm label or evidence override. Gold used only after answering.
failure_policy: Planned IDs stay in denominator; unknown judge coverage and answer errors are separate. No filtered-accuracy promotion.
accounting: Every formation, consolidation, Reader, support, repair and grading call. Shared ingestion once per visible-history hash. Missing usage stays unknown; retained upper reservation is not an invoice.
resume: Not implemented. Keep checkpoints, isolated databases and append-only calls. New execution is a new charged run.
interpretation_limits: All LoCoMo questions have been used for development; this is not unseen generalization.
External sources do not automatically activate personal Claim/View; report actual route coverage.
Full-framework comparison has different internal prompts/policies and is not a single-mechanism causal ablation.
No measured outcome exists under this protocol; old Token F1 scores are retired from current presentation.
